question: Why is the previously stated Uḍḍīśa teaching now being told to the goddess?
premises: The Uḍḍīśa teaching was previously stated by the speaker.
It is now being told to the goddess.
The reason given is her devotion.
inference: Because of her devotion, the Uḍḍīśa teaching previously stated by the speaker is now told to her.
plain_english: The Uḍḍīśa teaching previously stated by me is now told to you out of devotion.
